The cited record says ratification occurred on 16 January 2018, before López Obrador assumed office; it should be treated as inherited context, not an AMLO-period act."},{"question_id":"1B.6","issue_type":"material_omission","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0039-E002"],"explanation":"The draft omits the June 2023 Diario Oficial agreement establishing a Scientific Technical Committee on biosafety of genetically modified organisms. This is a target-year formal institutional control relevant to biological-risk governance, although the packet does not establish its staffing, powers, enforcement, or effectiveness."},{"question_id":"1B.6","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0047-E010","BATCH-0018-E013","BATCH-0026-E013"],"explanation":"Military cybersecurity breaches, Pegasus surveillance, and broader internet-governance weaknesses are only weakly related to proliferation controls. Including them at length risks conflating general security or rights failures with evidence of proliferation assistance, evasion, or export-control enforcement."},{"question_id":"1B.6","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0038-E002","BATCH-0040-E011"],"explanation":"The radiological-source thefts are relevant to radiological security but do not materially answer whether Mexico controlled nuclear, biological, or comparable weapons proliferation. The draft correctly disclaims the inference, but their inclusion adds little to this lens."},{"question_id":"1B.6","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0013-E005","BATCH-0040-E002","BATCH-0040-E007","BATCH-0043-E004","BATCH-0042-E002","BATCH-0044-E001"],"explanation":"The draft gives substantial space to diplomatic disarmament and nonproliferation positions. It appropriately qualifies them, but should make even clearer that these are low-weight contextual evidence for 1B.6 absent domestic controls, monitoring, enforcement, or a response to detected evasion."}],"overall_assessment":"The answer is substantively well calibrated: it distinguishes diplomatic engagement from enforceable proliferation controls, preserves the absence of documented enforcement evidence, and avoids inventing presidential attribution. The main correction is the false AMLO-period attribution of the 2018 TPNW ratification. It should also add the 2023 biosafety committee as a limited formal-control measure and trim or more sharply subordinate the cybersecurity, surveillance, and radiological-incident material."},"corrected":null}
